## Digital Twins for Manufacturing Scale Up


Viktor Rozsa


October 22, 2026


Use AI Physics to test more manufacturing scenarios before committing to costly scale-up trials. Rescale surrogate models can provide fast predictions across process parameters, equipment conditions, and material variations, helping manufacturing and process engineers compare options, identify promising operating windows, and focus physical validation where it matters most.


[Learn more](https://rescale.com/platform/ai-physics/) about digital twins powered by Rescale AI Physics.
